text:
maria: FYI customer asked for an air-gapped delivery: docker image with our runtime + quantized Cormac-7B weights. They want binary-only artifact, no source. Can we legally provide that?

jason-mlops: depends on upstream license. which release did you pull?

maria: hf://cormac-7b-v1 release. there's a license file on the release page.

oliver-research: quantizing usually doesn't change copyright status; but redistributing weights (quantized or not) may be covered by redistribution/derivative clauses. attribution/NOTICE might be required.

sara-legal: quick read: license disallows "redistribution in closed-source binary form" and mandates preserving NOTICE. That sounds like we can't ship a black-box image without fulfilling those terms.

maria: options I see: 1) hosted Dedicated so we keep weights (but customer needs on-prem); 2) give image but include license/NOTICE and ship runtime source; 3) negotiate a commercial sublicense with upstream.

rahul: 1 is easiest but won't meet their air-gap requirement.

jason-mlops: 2 is doable: include /usr/share/doc/CORMAC_LICENSE.txt and NOTICE and add CHANGES_QUANTIZATION.md describing quant steps and checksums. Do we need to include model training source? usually not, but if license treats quantized weights as derivative and has copyleft, they may demand source of modifications.

sara-legal: correct. if quantization is considered a modification, copyleft could trigger. I'll confirm whether this license's "derivative" language forces source disclosure. also flagging export controls  shipping weights cross-border may need screening.

oliver-research: we can document quantization pipeline: tool version, seeds, calibration data, exact CLI used, checksum of original and quantized weights. That helps provenance but doesn't override legal obligations.

maria: action items: Sara to give definitive interpretation by EOD; Jason to prepare packaging checklist and template docker snippet but hold on build; Rahul to add license-hash + legal-signoff step in pipeline metadata.

sara-legal: on it. if license is strict non-redistribution, we'll ask upstream about a paid sublicence.

jason-mlops: sample Dockerfile note (for later):
FROM redwood/inference-runtime:stable
COPY cormac-7b-qweights/ /opt/models/cormac-7b/
COPY CORMAC_LICENSE.txt /usr/share/doc/
COPY CORMAC_NOTICE.txt /usr/share/doc/
COPY CHANGES_QUANTIZATION.md /opt/models/cormac-7b/

maria: pausing build until legal confirms. thanks all. :thumbsup:
